summary: Stating she would seek AB 715/SB 48 implementation updates in district policy and would not use a school-board role for foreign-policy decisions or international boycotts, Mathews-Cain—a nonpartisan candidate for a Castro Valley Unified School District seat—supports discussion without identity-based targeting. She received a general-election endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated mission includes supporting Israel. The questionnaire response carries no stated date; only the September 2026 file upload is recorded.
